entries.name: Static Links + Stable Tier Layout
changes: Removed Patreon and Discord URL-input launchers and replaced them with plain readable text addresses
Supporter Guide now shows the same static Discord and Patreon addresses
Supporter tier wall starts at its final compact one-row height instead of shrinking after supporter data loads
Main Board player supporter badges use a fixed square size so they no longer resize when the tier sprite appears

entries.name: Link Prefill + Stats Cleanup
changes: Patreon and Discord native VRChat URL dialogs are now prefilled through the actual legacy VRCUrlInputField text value
Removes the media-field placeholder behaviour from supporter link launchers
Cleans up stacked V10/V11/V12/V13 local-performance cards before rebuilding the main-board FPS/PING display
Prevents faint duplicate text from appearing behind the main-board FPS and ping readout

entries.name: Native Links + Camera Layout Hotfix
changes: Moved the Gallery camera-mode control above the live preview and reduced its footprint so it no longer covers the image
Shortened camera-mode labels for the compact control
Patreon and Discord launcher cards now force VRChat's native URL/text input modal behaviour
Pre-fills the Patreon or Discord destination inside the native VRChat input box
Removes third-party keyboard overrides from supporter link fields that could suppress the native input modal

entries.name: Ping + YouTube Thumbnail Hotfix
changes: Replaced the local SimulationTime-based ping estimate that commonly sat around the replication buffer value
Local and self-reported player telemetry now use the SDK network round-trip statistic
Disabled Rinvo YouTube result darkening overlay that was making thumbnails almost black
Kept thumbnail masking while hiding the mask graphic so loaded cover images retain normal brightness

entries.name: Tier Wall + URL Field Hotfix
changes: Compact empty supporter tier sections so Basic is no longer clipped at the bottom
Added a persistent scrollbar to the supporter recognition wall
Patreon and Discord cards now use pre-filled VRCUrlInputField controls instead of the oversized media-style popup
Guide Patreon/Discord links use the same native VRChat URL input interaction

entries.name: Supporter + Background Polish
changes: Support Tiers is now the single supporter landing page; redundant Supporters navigation removed
Basic tier restored and all five supporter tiers remain available in the recognition wall
Benefits rebuilt as five clean scrollable tier cards with top-to-bottom navigation and masking
Badge page simplified so benefit descriptions are no longer repeated beneath badge artwork
Supporter Guide points users to the Verdant Discord first for setup, linking and help
Patreon and Discord QR codes removed in favour of clean link popups with selectable addresses
Main Board and Tablet background pickers now share one large-preview card layout
Background names are cleaned of GitHub, Remote, Free, file-extension and Tier suffix wording
Backgrounds sort free first, then Basic, Supporter, VIP, Elite and Guardian
Separate More Backgrounds section and the old backgrounds-page Patreon pin removed

entries.name: TMP Compile Hotfix
changes: Replaced unsupported TextAlignmentOptions.MidlineCenter values with TextAlignmentOptions.Center
Restores Unity editor compilation so the V13.1 rebuild menu can load

entries.name: Local Library & Supporter Polish
changes: Remote wallpaper catalogue retired; former hosted backgrounds are bundled locally for reliable instant previews
Removed user-facing GitHub and Free labels from background selection
Tablet background picker now uses preview cards and readable names matching the Main Board
Quick Notes now stays clipped inside its panel with vertical scrolling
Gallery can follow the active VRChat handheld Photo Camera when available, with hand and eye fallbacks
Supporter Benefits is masked, scrollable and spaced more cleanly
Patreon and Discord link cards added with local icons and QR/link popups
Supporters can display their tier badge above their avatar and opt out from the Benefits page

entries.name: Unified System
changes: Supporter Board redesigned around Guardian, Elite, VIP, Supporter and Basic recognition sections with live counts
Personal Tablet, Main Board and Shared Video Player retain their familiar layouts while sharing the same media and state architecture
Staff Pad player-management actions expanded with Freeze, Send to Spawn, Media Lock and safer world-local restriction state
Permanent Unity staff roles plus optional remote Manager, Admin and Moderator assignments from config/staff.json
Supporter item registry added for rank-gated world items, doors, pickups and interactions
Remote background labels cleaned so technical GitHub/file wording never appears to visitors
Local media volume persistence and clearer Ready, Loading, Playing, Paused and Error states
Verdant cats preserve their existing manually positioned scene transforms during rebuilds

entries.name: Guardian Moderation
changes: Staff Pad overhaul with cleaner player selection and grouped moderation controls
World-local Warn, Force Mute, Travel Lock, Pickup Lock and TP-to-Spawn actions
Owner-only supporter self-preview and complimentary courtesy roles
Reusable supporter portals with local fade transitions and tier gates
GitHub background manifest compatibility fix for baseUrl/path/requiredTier
Remote background thumbnail cards replace the black template automatically when loaded
Existing manually positioned Verdant cats are preserved during rebuilds

entries.name: Patreon Identity
changes: Five Patreon ranks: Basic, Supporter, VIP, Elite, Guardian
Elite/Guardian persistent custom name colour
Elite/Guardian rank-specific join intros and optional short title
Patreon rank separated from staff authority
Tier badges and backgrounds organised for GitHub hosting

entries.title: Apps Isolation Hotfix
notes: Removed Personal Locomotion from the Apps comfort page
Fixed app-tab overlap caused by the Comfort module reactivating its whole page
Added runtime app-panel isolation and reflowed the Comfort layout

entries.title: Universal Apps
notes: Supporter, badge, gallery and community content foundations
